findings.title: Armed auth release publishes gnu binaries with a glibc floor of the build runner
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same glibc-floor concern as F-02, supported by plain napi build on recent runners versus the FFI zigbuild .2.28 pin and the preflight's lack of symbol-version checks.

findings.title: musl leg produces no .node and the armed release holds every JS publish on that push
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Claim that no .node is produced and the build fails loudly rests on unverified rustc behaviour; the cited code does not show the build fails, and the actual risk is a mis-linked binary being produced.

findings.title: Widened release-plz trigger boots the armed EQL crates job on unrelated root Cargo changes
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Widened push filter boots the credentialed EQL release job on root-workspace pushes, contrary to the file's own comment; supported by cited lines.
